---
title: "Synthetic demonstration -- no study data"
---

Every value on this page is constructed by `cw_demo_cases()` with a fixed seed.
The data are unrelated to the project question or datasets, nothing is read from
the project and no files are written. Each model adapter is compared with an
independent reference computation; the comparison checks software, not a
scientific hypothesis.

```{r synthetic-demo}
source("../code/R/cttir_figures.R", local = TRUE)
source("../code/R/cttir_workflow.R", local = TRUE)
spec <- cw_read_yaml("../cttir-project.yml")
receipt <- cw_run_demo(root = "..", figures_policy = spec$figures, write = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(receipt$status, "passed"))
checks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(receipt$cases), function(name) {
  x <- receipt$cases[[name]]
  data.frame(case = name, engine = x$engine, reference = x$reference$name,
    max_abs_difference = max(abs(x$reference$observed - x$reference$expected)), passed = x$reference$pass)
}))
knitr::kable(checks, caption = "Synthetic adapter checks against independent references")
```

```{r synthetic-effects}
case <- cw_demo_cases()$continuous
tidy <- cw_tidy(case$data, case$analysis)
effects <- cw_effects(cw_model(tidy, case$analysis))
knitr::kable(effects[c("term_original", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")], digits = 3,
  caption = "Synthetic linear model estimates; not study results")
```
